ruleDefinitions.name: Dump Ntds.dit To Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential abuse of ntdsutil to dump ntds.dit database to a suspicious location Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, Data

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "ESENT" AND event_id = 325 AND Data = RGX(".*ntds\\\.dit.*")) AND (Data = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ntds\\\.dit.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Appdata\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR Data = RGX(".*\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*")))
